description:
Fetch all rune token balances held at a Bitcoin address via the Unisat indexer.

Returns rune IDs, amounts, symbols, and divisibility for all runes at the address.

If no address is provided, uses the active wallet's Taproot address.
Set UNISAT_API_KEY for higher rate limits (5 req/s on free tier).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Bitcoin address to check (uses active wallet's Taproot address if omitted)

name: get_rune_balances
